## 1.3.42 (HexGhoul): Home Living, part 3: your partner cooks the cookbook's dishes at home (testing)
HexKagune 1.3.42 for Forge 1.20.1. Install on client and server (**protocol 67**, unchanged). Testing build: compiled, tests pass, **not tried in game**.

- **Your partner cooks the cookbook's dishes.** At the home you share, when the home's chests (plain chests and barrels) hold everything a recipe of The Ghoul's Kitchen needs, your partner cooks it as one of their chores: they go to the chest (lid up, bent over it), take everything the recipe needs, cook at the stove with the same stirring animation as before, and the dish appears instantly.
  - **Prep on the way.** If a recipe needs something the chests don't have but can be made from what they do have, they make that first, up to two steps back. Raw human meat, a bottle and bread can become a Sausage Roll: they make the mince, the bottled blood and the Blood Sausage along the way. Leftover prep (two more sausages) goes in the chest.
  - **Searing needs the stove.** Seared Human Meat and Seared Ghoul Meat (and any dish that needs them) need a campfire, or a furnace or smoker with fuel in the chests (two seared items per coal, as before). Dishes with no searing are cooked at the stove anyway, or at a table, or right by the chest if the home has neither.
  - **Nothing lost.** Everything is taken out in one go; if anything turns out to be missing, it all goes back. Buckets and bottles come back as they do in crafting (the bucket from RC Broth's water or a milk recipe, the glass bottle from Bottled Blood or honey).
  - **Where the dish goes.** It's kept as your meal first (up to 6 portions in all, as before) and the rest goes in the chest. If you're there and they can see you, they hand it to you on the spot ("I made Crimson Curry. ..."). If you're out, they give it to you when you come home, and if it went in the chest they tell you so ("I made Kakuja Burger while you were out. It's in the chest.").
- **What they choose.** Dishes with effects first: more effects, longer and stronger ones, rank higher. They pick at random among the best three, and never the same dish twice in a row while another is possible. If the last dish took the last of an ingredient another recipe also needs, this time they leave the rest alone (never twice in a row).
- **Meals, not a factory.** At most 4 dishes a day, at least 2 minutes apart. The old cooking (vanilla raw food, raw cuts set aside) carries on in between.
- **Only for a ghoul spouse.** Every dish in the book has ghoul meat (it would make a human sick) or human meat in it, and they won't feed their human spouse a person. If you're human, they keep cooking you ordinary food as before.
- **`/kagune home`** now lists the cookbook dishes the chests could make right now and how many they've cooked today.

Untested in game: compiled and unit tested only. Try: marry, declare the home, put a bowl, a Seared Human Meat, a potato, a carrot and blaze powder in a chest beside a furnace with coal, and wait for a cooking chore (`/kagune home` shows "could make Crimson Curry").
